radiology_notes.text:
REASON FOR EXAMINATION:  Fever.

Portable AP chest radiograph was compared to ___.

The lung volumes are lower than on the prior study which may explain bibasal
opacities that could be due to atelectasis although infectious process cannot
be excluded.  Upper lungs are clear.  Cardiomediastinal silhouette is stable
allowing the low lung volumes.  The double-lumen dialysis catheter tip is in
the right atrium.  Repeated radiograph with improved inspiratory effort is
recommended for evaluation of the lung bases; it might help to distinguish
between atelectasis and infection.  No pneumothorax.
